title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Repayment Terms: Installment Frequency, Missed Deductions and Direct Pay
content:
**Repayment terms of the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan.** Installments follow the worker's pay frequency, and the settings below govern a missed deduction and a move to direct ACH payments. They are identical across Paystride Payroll Loan 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 and 5000.

| Repayment setting | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Installments follow the worker's pay frequency | each payday |
| Later paydays a missed installment is added to | 1 |
| The loan converts to monthly direct ACH payments when employment ends | Yes |
| Day of the month direct payments fall due after conversion | 15 |
| Revoking the payroll deduction authorization converts repayment to direct ACH | Yes |

**Each payday.** An installment is scheduled for each payday of the worker.

**Missed deduction.** A missed installment is added to 1 later payday, that is, to the next payday.

**Direct pay.** Both the end of employment and a revocation of the payroll deduction authorization convert repayment to direct ACH. After conversion, payments are monthly and fall due on the 15th day of the month.

Hypothetical illustration: a worker paid every two weeks whose deduction is missed on one payday has that installment added to the following payday, which then carries two installments. A borrower whose repayment has converted to direct ACH makes one payment a month, due on the 15th of the month.
